negativeSampleRefs.observation: The false PASS includes merged ㄱ/ㄴ/ㄷ blocks, runtime TeX escaping that source inspection missed, and SVG text whose claimed geometry did not match primitive coordinates. Keep enumerated decisions visibly separate and validate runtime strings and any visual against actual content.
The displayed line claims slope −5/6 and y-intercept −7/6, while its primitive crosses the axes' origin; check actual coordinates, not labels alone.
